cohort: The study followed 95 adult overweight and obese women (BMI >= 25 kg/m2) from early pregnancy until 60 to 180 days postpartum.
finding: Breastfeeding was inversely associated with improved markers of insulin resistance (fasting glucose, HOMA-IR, TyG index, and TG/HDL ratio) in overweight and obese postpartum women, and subclinical inflammation did not mediate this association.
